values: Fill the sheets with real or approved demo business/utility data for the UtilityOps hackathon build.
Do not enter passwords, bank details, government IDs, or unnecessary personal information.
Store, supervisor, utility, billing-period, consumption, bill amount, and historical records where available.
Upload a bill document separately if available; do not paste sensitive document contents into this workbook.
Use only the dropdown values provided in each sheet.
Use INR amounts without the ₹ symbol in numeric cells.
Do not decide or label anomalies yourself unless the value is an existing business-approved flag. The application should calculate/analyze anomalies.
